Advances: specled.verification

DESCOPED OUT OF specled_-ymn, 2026-07-26, by orchestrator decision during epic specled_-233. This is the F2/CF2 item from the specled_-hyt pre-ship critical review (L severity, consensus idioms+simplicity, recorded on ymn as 'worth folding in'). It was implemented in ymn iteration 1 and then deliberately REVERTED in iteration 3. Recording it here so the reduction is explicit rather than silent.

THE ITEM. The cross-VM temp-name rationale is re-narrated at three sites in lib/specled_ex/verifier.ex — :2174 (the streaming attribution sidecar), :2304-2305 (the command temp script), :2404-2405 (the forensic capture log). The ask was to trim each to a one-line pointer at SpecLedEx.TempName so the moduledoc is the single narrative. A fourth narration at lib/specled_ex/compiler/tracer.ex:339 is LOAD-BEARING and must be kept: it explains why the tracer cannot call TempName at all (Mix prunes undeclared deps from a host project's code path), in a module where that constraint is invisible.

WHY IT WAS REVERTED, not abandoned as wrong. Editing verifier.ex drags specled.prose_guard into the branch-guard impacted set, because verifier.ex sits on prose_guard's surface (prose_guard.spec.md:19) even though prose guarding has nothing to do with temp names. prose_guard binds no code in that file, so no realization-attestation downgrade is available — unlike specled.decisions, which downgrades to INFO via SpecLedEx.Verifier.verify_decision/4. That left exactly two ways to green mix spec.check:
  (a) co-change prose_guard.spec.md and/or add the cross_vm_temp_names_reach ADR to its decisions: list — which asserts that a temp-naming decision governs prose guarding. That is FALSE, and it is the same over-claim ymn iteration 1 was bounced for. Rejected.
  (b) revert verifier.ex and drop the comment trim. Chosen.
So an L-severity comment-tidying item was traded away rather than buying it with a false spec-graph assertion. That is the right trade, but it is a real scope reduction and the item is genuinely still undone.

DOING IT LATER IS CHEAP BUT NOT FREE. Whoever picks this up hits the same wall: any verifier.ex edit re-opens branch_guard_missing_subject_update against specled.prose_guard. Options, none of which ymn was scoped to take:
  - Bundle it with work that legitimately advances specled.prose_guard, so the co-change is honest.
  - Fix the root cause instead: prose_guard's surface list claims a 3800-line general-purpose module because SpecLedEx.Verifier happens to host prose-finding emission. If prose emission moved to its own module, or if surface membership could be narrowed below whole-file granularity, this class of false coupling disappears for every future ticket. That is the more valuable ticket and is worth considering before doing the cosmetic trim.
  - Accept the co-change as mechanically required bookkeeping with no semantic claim, if the project decides a decisions: link is not an assertion of governance. That is a policy call, not an implementation one.

STATE AT REVERT. ymn iteration 1's version of the trim was reviewed and found ACCEPTABLE by cold audit pass 1, which overturned a verifier Gap claiming the trim lost rationale: the exit-127 command-script story survives as accepted normative text at .spec/specs/verification.spec.md:84-92 (specled.verify.command_temp_names_cross_vm_unique, priority: must), and the sidecar cover_not_executed story at .spec/specs/tagged_tests_verification.spec.md:279-288. Only the shared-capture-dir forensic-log rationale is thinner in spec text — specled.verify.command_output_capture_dir says only 'a uniquely named file'. If this trim is redone, consider strengthening that one requirement in the same pass so the pointer target is complete.

Not urgent. Cosmetic. No behavioral or verification consequence.

ADMISSION VERIFICATION (specled_-k6s, 2026-07-27)
Cold fresh-context verifier run against the epic base tree (feat/specled_-td7-self-identifying-descriptors @ e81f9f98).

VERDICT: still_applicable   EFFORT: trivial
Mandate confirmed still applicable as written; no narrowing needed.

== SCOPED REMAINING WORK ==
1. lib/specled_ex/verifier.ex:2172-2174 — replace the 3-line comment above `artifact_path = …` in `run_merged_command/5` with a one-line pointer, e.g. `# Cross-VM-unique name — see SpecLedEx.TempName.`
2. lib/specled_ex/verifier.ex:2306-2308 — same trim for the comment above `tmp_out = …` in `run_command/4`.
3. lib/specled_ex/verifier.ex:2424-2426 — same trim for the comment above `path = Path.join(dir, …)` in `preserve_failed_output/4`.
4. DO NOT touch lib/specled_ex/compiler/tracer.ex:335-341 — that narration is load-bearing (explains why the tracer cannot call TempName at all) and the ticket explicitly exempts it.
5. OPTIONAL, recommended in the same pass (makes the pointer target complete for site 3): in .spec/specs/verification.spec.md, requirement `specled.verify.command_output_capture_dir` (statement at :138-149), replace "a uniquely named file in that directory" with a clause requiring cross-VM uniqueness via `SpecLedEx.TempName.cross_vm_suffix/0`, mirroring the wording already accepted at :87-91 for `specled.verify.command_temp_names_cross_vm_unique`. If you do this, verification.spec.md IS co-changed, which additionally removes any branch-guard question for specled.verification.
6. No new tests are needed — nothing in the repo asserts on these comment strings (`grep -rn "Cross-VM-unique name"` outside verifier.ex returns nothing).
7. Ensure at least one commit in the range keeps the `Spec-Drift: branch_guard_missing_subject_update=info` trailer already used by every commit on this branch, so the prose_guard INFO stays INFO.

== EXPECTED TOUCHES ==
lib/specled_ex/verifier.ex, .spec/specs/verification.spec.md

== RISK NOTES ==
REALIZATION HASH: no risk. .spec/realization_hashes.json contains only the `api_boundary` tier (172 entries; `python3` walk of the file shows no `implementation` key), and the only SpecLedEx.Verifier entries are `SpecLedEx.Verifier.verify/3` and `SpecLedEx.Verifier.verify_decision/4`. All three comments sit inside private functions (`run_merged_command/5`, `run_command/4`, `preserve_failed_output/4`) that are not bound, and lib/specled_ex/realization/api_boundary.ex:8-9 documents the api_boundary hash as stable under "line-number shifts of the function's source position — including edits above it". Deleting 6 comment lines cannot move a baselined hash.

BRANCH GUARD: editing verifier.ex pulls specled.prose_guard (prose_guard.spec.md:19 surface) and specled.decisions into the impacted set. On this branch both already resolve to INFO — decisions via realization attestation of `SpecLedEx.Verifier.verify_decision/4`, prose_guard via the `Spec-Drift: branch_guard_missing_subject_update=info` trailer present on all 9 commits. The ticket's claim that this is a hard blocker requiring a false decisions: link is WRONG in this tree; do not let an implementer add specled.decision.cross_vm_temp_names_reach to prose_guard.spec.md's decisions: list to "fix" it. Since verifier.ex is ALREADY modified by td7 in this PR, the marginal branch-guard cost of this ticket is exactly zero.

SPEC REQUIREMENT OVERLAP: item 5 edits `specled.verify.command_output_capture_dir` (verification.spec.md:137-149). specled_-4f7 is scoped to the same requirement's arming path (its own header: "the forensics behavior it feeds is specled.verify.command_output_capture_dir") but 4f7's remaining work per its 2026-07-27 comment is confined to .claude/settings.json distribution, not the requirement text — low collision risk, but sequence 4f7 and chb rather than running them in parallel if item 5 is taken. specled_-zek also advances specled.verification and will edit verification.spec.md; specled_-ehv edits .spec/decisions/specled.decision.cross_vm_temp_names*.md on the identical cross-VM topic and its description explicitly cross-references chb — land ehv's ADR wording decision BEFORE chb's pointer trim if you want the pointer to aim at final text (soft ordering preference, not a hard dependency).

SAME-FILE, DIFFERENT-REGION: specled_-14t edits lib/specled_ex/verifier.ex at `valid_decision_affect?/4` (:2095, plus call sites :1723 and :1921); specled_-4a6 may consolidate verifier.ex decision-parse logic. Neither overlaps lines 2172/2306/2424, but all three land in one PR so expect merge-order churn on verifier.ex line numbers — apply chb's trim by anchor text, not by line number.

GATES: `mix spec.check --no-run-commands` currently passes on this tree (verdict `spec.check result=pass`, errors=0). This change is comment-only and cannot affect test outcomes.

SCOPE CONTRACT (orchestrator, specled_-k6s — 2026-07-27)

Authoritative for mechanical scope checks. Supplements, does not replace, the
ADMISSION VERIFICATION comment's mandate (items 1-7), which is what you implement.

SEQUENCING NOTE: specled_-ehv has already landed its wording decision in
`.spec/decisions/specled.decision.cross_vm_temp_names_reach.md`. Read that ADR
on your base BEFORE trimming, so your one-line pointers aim at final text.

## Allowed touches
- `lib/specled_ex/verifier.ex` — the three comment blocks ONLY (above
  `artifact_path = …` in `run_merged_command/5`, above `tmp_out = …` in
  `run_command/4`, and above `path = Path.join(dir, …)` in
  `preserve_failed_output/4`). Apply by ANCHOR TEXT, not by line number —
  other tickets in this PR shift this file's line numbers.
- `.spec/specs/verification.spec.md` — item 5 only: the
  `specled.verify.command_output_capture_dir` statement. Spec co-change is
  AUTHORIZED and is recommended here; it also settles the branch-guard question
  for `specled.verification`.

## Out of Scope (files)
- `lib/specled_ex/compiler/tracer.ex` (~:335-341) — item 4 is explicit: that
  narration is LOAD-BEARING (it explains why the tracer cannot call TempName at
  all) and the ticket exempts it. Do not touch it.
- `.spec/specs/prose_guard.spec.md` — the ticket body claims a `decisions:` link
  is needed there. THE ADMISSION PASS PROVED THAT WRONG in this tree. Do NOT add
  `specled.decision.cross_vm_temp_names_reach` to prose_guard's `decisions:` list.
  A false spec-graph assertion to quiet a guard is an automatic bounce.
- `.spec/decisions/specled.decision.cross_vm_temp_names_reach.md` — specled_-ehv
  owns it. Point AT it; do not edit it.
- `CHANGELOG.md` (orchestrator consolidates once at the end), `VERSION`,
  `.spec/realization_hashes.json`, `.spec/state.json`.
- Every file not listed under Allowed touches.

## Out of Scope (intent)
- No behavior change whatsoever. This is a comment trim plus one optional
  requirement-wording tightening. No new tests are needed — nothing in the repo
  asserts on these comment strings.
- Do not restructure, rename, or refactor the three private functions.
- `.spec/specs/verification.spec.md` is append-only-checked: item 5 TIGHTENS the
  statement (adds a cross-VM-uniqueness clause mirroring the accepted wording at
  `specled.verify.command_temp_names_cross_vm_unique`). Do not delete or weaken it.
- No new dependencies.

## Verification (change-scoped, run-until-green; host mix, no compose)
1. `mix compile --warnings-as-errors`
2. `mix format --check-formatted`
3. `mix spec.check --no-run-commands` — expect `spec.check result=pass`.
4. `git diff --stat -- .spec/realization_hashes.json` must be EMPTY.
5. Your commit MUST carry the `Spec-Drift: branch_guard_missing_subject_update=info`
   trailer, as every commit on this branch does, so the prose_guard finding stays INFO.

Do NOT run bare `mix spec.check` and do NOT run the full suite. The orchestrator
owns whole-system proof at the merge gate and PR CI.
